reason: E1 supports the first three premises by describing the heterogeneous microstructure and simultaneous strength-ductility enhancement from cryo-rolling and annealing. However, the hypothesis replaces annealing with warm-rolling, claiming it will promote controlled recrystallization without coarsening; no cited evidence supports this specific substitution or its claimed advantages over the documented annealing route.
premises: Cryo-rolling followed by annealing produces a heterogeneous microstructure in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA
That heterogeneous microstructure consists of retained lamellar and coarse non-lamellar regions with ultrafine recrystallized FCC and coarse recovered B2 grains
This microstructure simultaneously enhances strength and ductility
Warm-rolling can substitute for annealing to promote controlled dynamic recrystallization without coarsening
